Aleatorik 3 products » About Aleatorik Aleatorik was founded in 2003 by recording engineer Hitoshi (Jin) Terada, who has over 30 years of experience as an engineer, mixer, and producer. Production is extremely limited (around 15 units per month) due to his recording work. The Operation 1-4 pedals are fully hand-built with three-dimensional wiring, no PCBs, and no soldering at component terminals. Materials include cryo-treated Northern Electric wire, copper, silver-plated, and silver wiring, as well as cryo-treated jacks and switches. This construction preserves harmonics and produces a rich, natural sound that reflects Terada's ideals as a studio engineer. Hitoshi Terada began building radios in elementary school and later joined his university’s Broadcasting Research Club, where he constructed mixing consoles, tape recorders, and effects while also playing in bands. After graduation, he worked as chief engineer at a guitar manufacturer, developing guitars, effects, and amplifiers. He later became a recording engineer and mixer, working with numerous bands and artists. For over 30 years, he has been active in recording, mixing, and producing, alongside building Aleatorik effects since 2003.
